## Why it matters

UB Heidelberg brings together major digitized holdings such as manuscripts from the Bibliotheca Palatina, charters, incunabula, historical maps, newspapers, and subject collections.

The site is especially useful when research crosses formats or periods, since it links primary sources and scholarly literature within one long-running university digitization program.
